item.title: FanDuel CEO says gambling site is working closely with NFL to ensure Super Bowl is gambled on responsibly
item.description: By Kyle Feldscher, CNN San Francisco (CNN) — FanDuel CEO Amy Howe told CNN Sports on Friday her company is working closely with the NFL to ensure that enormous events like the Super Bowl, one of the games that draws the most action annually, are insulated from problematic gambling.
